sql.sql: SELECT call.filter_status, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM genomics.variant_calls call JOIN genomics.samples sample ON sample.id = call.sample_id WHERE sample.is_control = false GROUP BY call.filter_status ORDER BY calls DESC, call.filter_status
SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_confidence_calls FROM genomics.variant_calls call JOIN genomics.samples sample ON sample.id = call.sample_id WHERE sample.is_control = false AND call.filter_status = 'PASS'

SELECT CASE WHEN call.genotype_quality >= 20 THEN 'high-confidence' ELSE 'low-confidence' END AS confidence, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM genomics.variant_calls call JOIN genomics.samples sample ON sample.id = call.sample_id WHERE sample.is_control = false GROUP BY CASE WHEN call.genotype_quality >= 20 THEN 'high-confidence' ELSE 'low-confidence' END ORDER BY calls DESC

cases.question: How many high-confidence variant calls did each assay type produce?

attempts.finalSql: SELECT sample.assay, COUNT(*) AS high_confidence_calls FROM genomics.variant_calls call JOIN genomics.samples sample ON sample.id = call.sample_id WHERE sample.is_control = false AND call.filter_status = 'PASS' GROUP BY sample.assay ORDER BY sample.assay

sql.sql: SELECT sample.assay, COUNT(*) AS high_confidence_calls FROM genomics.variant_calls call JOIN genomics.samples sample ON sample.id = call.sample_id WHERE sample.is_control = false AND call.filter_status = 'PASS' GROUP BY sample.assay ORDER BY sample.assay

SELECT sample.assay, COUNT(*) AS high_confidence_calls FROM genomics.variant_calls call JOIN genomics.samples sample ON sample.id = call.sample_id WHERE sample.is_control = false GROUP BY sample.assay ORDER BY sample.assay

cases.question: Which five genes have the most high-confidence variant calls?

attempts.finalSql: SELECT gene.hgnc_symbol AS gene, COUNT(*) AS high_confidence_calls FROM genomics.variant_calls call JOIN genomics.samples sample ON sample.id = call.sample_id JOIN genomics.variants variant ON variant.id = call.variant_id JOIN genomics.genes gene ON gene.id = variant.gene_id WHERE sample.is_control = false AND call.filter_status = 'PASS' GROUP BY gene.hgnc_symbol ORDER BY high_confidence_calls DESC, gene.hgnc_symbol LIMIT 5

sql.sql: SELECT gene.hgnc_symbol AS gene, COUNT(*) AS high_confidence_calls FROM genomics.variant_calls call JOIN genomics.samples sample ON sample.id = call.sample_id JOIN genomics.variants variant ON variant.id = call.variant_id JOIN genomics.genes gene ON gene.id = variant.gene_id WHERE sample.is_control = false AND call.filter_status = 'PASS' GROUP BY gene.hgnc_symbol ORDER BY high_confidence_calls DESC, gene.hgnc_symbol LIMIT 5

SELECT gene.hgnc_symbol AS gene, COUNT(*) AS high_confidence_calls FROM genomics.variant_calls call JOIN genomics.samples sample ON sample.id = call.sample_id JOIN genomics.variants variant ON variant.id = call.variant_id JOIN genomics.genes gene ON gene.id = variant.gene_id WHERE sample.is_control = false GROUP BY gene.hgnc_symbol ORDER BY high_confidence_calls DESC, gene.hgnc_symbol LIMIT 5

cases.question: What is the average sequencing coverage for each assay type?

attempts.finalSql: SELECT sample.assay, COUNT(*) AS samples, ROUND(AVG(sample.mean_coverage), 1) AS avg_mean_coverage FROM genomics.samples sample WHERE sample.is_control = false GROUP BY sample.assay ORDER BY sample.assay

sql.sql: SELECT sample.assay, COUNT(*) AS samples, ROUND(AVG(sample.mean_coverage), 1) AS avg_mean_coverage FROM genomics.samples sample WHERE sample.is_control = false GROUP BY sample.assay ORDER BY sample.assay

SELECT sample.assay, COUNT(*) AS samples, ROUND(SUM(sample.mean_coverage), 1) AS avg_mean_coverage FROM genomics.samples sample WHERE sample.is_control = false GROUP BY sample.assay ORDER BY sample.assay

cases.question: How many megabases does the DMD gene span, to two decimal places?

attempts.finalSql: SELECT ROUND((gene.end_position - gene.start_position + 1) / 1000000.0, 2) AS span_mb FROM genomics.genes gene WHERE gene.hgnc_symbol = 'DMD'

sql.sql: SELECT ROUND((gene.end_position - gene.start_position + 1) / 1000000.0, 2) AS span_mb FROM genomics.genes gene WHERE gene.hgnc_symbol = 'DMD'
SELECT gene.end_position - gene.start_position + 1 AS span_mb FROM genomics.genes gene WHERE gene.hgnc_symbol = 'DMD'

cases.question: What is the average length of a canonical transcript, in kilobases to one decimal place?

attempts.finalSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(transcript.length_bp) / 1000.0, 1) AS mean_length_kb FROM genomics.transcripts transcript WHERE transcript.is_canonical = true

sql.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(transcript.length_bp) / 1000.0, 1) AS mean_length_kb FROM genomics.transcripts transcript WHERE transcript.is_canonical = true
SELECT ROUND(AVG(transcript.length_bp), 1) AS mean_length_kb FROM genomics.transcripts transcript WHERE transcript.is_canonical = true

cases.question: How many variants of each type do we have?

sql.sql: SELECT variant.variant_type, COUNT(*) AS variants FROM genomics.variants variant GROUP BY variant.variant_type ORDER BY variants DESC, variant.variant_type

cases.question: How many samples did we collect in each year, counting every sample on record, controls included?
